entities.summary: Pepe Lienhard (b. 1946-03-23, Lenzburg) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Lenzburg and Switzerland. Known in the fields of switzerland, composers & musicians, europe.
